grounding_gaps.reason: The provider pack models the PyLabRobot 0.2.1 Chatterbox device-free reference, not robot firmware, VENUS, calibration, timing, collisions, or liquid classes.
The internal HTTPS projection is consumed by the Datalox PyLabRobot backend; evaluated programs continue to call LiquidHandler methods.

lifecycle_contract: setup registers an eight-channel deck snapshot and fails when repeated while running; stop transitions running to stopped and fails when repeated; tip pickup/drop and aspirate/dispense are atomic across each batch and expose native PyLabRobot error names for invalid state.
scope_boundary: Standard eight-channel device-free setup, stop, tip pickup/drop, aspiration, dispense, and state inspection. CoRe 96, iSWAP, physical motion, calibration, VENUS, auxiliary instruments, and Hamilton liquid-class execution are excluded.
